name: vachan-emulator-tests
description: Security-rules and end-to-end tests against the local Firebase emulators

scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:rules: NODE_OPTIONS="$NODE_OPTIONS --require $PWD/scripts/loopback-direct.cjs" firebase emulators:exec --project demo-vachan --only firestore,storage --config ../firebase.json "vitest run rules.test.ts"
scripts.test:e2e: NODE_OPTIONS="$NODE_OPTIONS --require $PWD/scripts/loopback-direct.cjs" firebase emulators:exec --project demo-vachan --only auth,functions,firestore,storage --config ../firebase.json "vitest run e2e.test.ts"
